parsed.attack: One-time purchase into a sliver of a sliver. K-12 teachers number about 3.2M in the US, of whom the share running a daily personal spaced-repetition review is low single digits - call it 50-100k worldwide on iPhone - and at $9.99 netting $8.49 even a spectacular 10% penetration is 5-10k units, $42-85k lifetime, with no second month because the model never renews. Paid acquisition is closed outright: $5.84 iOS CPI needs 69% install-to-purchase at $9.99, $1.92 Android needs 23%, and their own kill line 3 concedes the entire channel is forum threads about a CSV workaround. Their kill line 4 then allows up to 10% refunds, which removes a tenth of gross before the 15% store cut on a product that has no recurring revenue to recover it from.
parsed.strongest_defence: On-device vision means zero COGS, so organic-only is 100% margin; the SRS community is unusually dense, self-selecting and free to reach, a $9.99 utility with no competitor can plausibly do several thousand units there, and because the cards live in the deck the buyer already maintains there is no separate app to abandon - which is the failure mode that killed every relationship tool in the graveyard.
parsed.verdict_reason: Zero COGS makes organic sales pure margin, but a non-renewing $8.49 net unit cannot absorb even an Android install, so the ceiling is a five-figure lifetime take from one unpaid forum channel.
